about: Every file under results/ -> the commit of the DEVELOPMENT repository (where the study was run; not shipped) that last changed it, whether this copy differs from that commit, and, where pipeline.json records it, the architecture/image it was produced on. documented_host=null means it is not recorded; nothing is inferred. Written with python3 -I scripts/provenance.py --index --dev-repo DIR; without DIR, --check compares the file list and the documented hosts only.
